title: Root ↔ Seed Temporal Contract — Provenance, Present Viability and Future Capacity
purpose: Separate Root and Seed across botanical, archival, genealogical, theological and systems uses while defining their mature temporal relation inside the Potato of Life.

temporal_relation.root: what carries support, ancestry, source conditions, dependencies, memory and causal/provenance continuity from what came before
temporal_relation.here_now: what is actually available in the current state
temporal_relation.seed: what compresses viable transferable capacity for what may begin next
temporal_relation.law: Root points backward/downward into provenance and support; Seed points forward into conditional generativity. Here/Now mediates between them.

root_types.meaning: plant organ/system for anchorage, absorption, transport, storage and signaling
root_types.boundary: Biological root findings constrain analogies but do not prove symbolic provenance claims.

root_types.meaning: source lineage, dependency chain, historical predecessor or causal support
root_types.boundary: Provenance is not identical to blame or moral origin.
Genealogy does not imply authority or worth.

root_types.meaning: origin/generative continuity associated with Father/source-facing role
root_types.boundary: Conceptual source may be represented above while roots deploy spatially downward; causal origin and drawing position are distinct dimensions.

root_types.meaning: integrated provenance/support that nourishes future growth
post-rupture provenance/residue that may remain inert, feed Strife, or be processed toward Soil/Life
unresolved support structure that reproduces conflict, capture or dependency

seed_types.meaning: plant reproductive propagule with embryo and stored/protective structures depending species
seed_types.boundary: Potato tuber/eye is vegetative propagation, not a botanical seed.

seed_types.meaning: seed/grain imagery tied to sowing, death, multiplication and harvest in source texts
vegetative bud capable of producing a new potato plant under conditions
seed_types.boundary: Useful Potato comparator but technically distinct from seed.

seed_types.meaning: compressed transferable future capacity that may remain dormant, decay, root or sprout
potential in burial/surrender/compression where prior form has ceased or been interrupted
potential that has become viable for rooting/sprouting and future growth
future capacity generated from mature Fruit/output and returned for another cycle
minimal record/input used to initialize a dataset, model, timeline or future work
seed_types.boundary: Technical seed does not inherit spiritual meaning by default.

root_seed_cycle: current Body/World state expresses what those conditions presently support
Here/Now distinguishes live state from historical residue and future projection
Fruit/consequence reveals what the process actually produced
planting/rooting creates a new provenance chain
the next cycle inherits but does not duplicate the previous one

viability_contract.rule: Potential without specified viability conditions is not enough to call something a living/generative Seed; history without a current support relation is not enough to call something an active Root.

temporal_firewalls: Root != past event itself; it is the surviving support/provenance relation from the past.
Seed != prediction; it is conditional capacity from the current state.
Memory != Root automatically; memory becomes Root when it materially supports/orients current structure.
Idea != Seed automatically; an idea becomes Seed-like when it can be transferred, instantiated or developed under conditions.
Burial != death proof and death != future germination proof.
Father/Root relation is project theology, not botanical identity.
Jesus/Here is the present transition anchor; Seed begins from the present but is not identical with Jesus.
Axial distance from O is not chronological age; old/new, deep/shallow and up/down remain distinct coordinates.

archive_application.root: source records, provenance, predecessor entities, dated development and dependencies
archive_application.seed: future research question, portable pattern, reusable schema, next project state
archive_application.pruning: archive or demote redundant branch while preserving provenance

field_mapping.root: Root/provenance can spread across -z/lower sections while retaining a live support path to current structure.
field_mapping.seed: Seed is present conditional capacity that may enter either rooting or sprouting trajectories.
field_mapping.rooting_spiral: negative z with viable support formation and later return/growth
field_mapping.strife_spiral: negative z with decreasing correction/exit and increasing compulsory recurrence
field_mapping.return: Fruit/Seed may descend toward O/Plane without being fall/Strife.
